title: Dragging Bodies
body:
Dragging Bodies is a plugin which gives you 1 additional choice when you kill a player. Normally in the game player would die but now instead of dying he just got knocked out, while a player is knocked out you can spare him or transport him to a different location using lead(aim at the direction of the floor), but you need to be quick since you have only 5 minutes!

**ONLY Supported Version: 1.21, 1.21.1**
**Support:** [Github](https://github.com/ZedaMC/Dragging-Bodies)

Planned changes:
- More options in the config
- Stop using NMS after spigot api adds .noPhysics
- NMS for multiple versions
- Optimization if possible
Please report issues on Github, only supported version at this time is 1.21 and 1.21.1.
